jobs.description:
Opening:

We are revolutionizing the Media industry with cutting-edge technology for probing, monitoring, and high-quality visualization of IP workflows. With over 250,000 monitoring points worldwide, our Realtime Media Performance Platform is trusted by the largest media companies on the planet across Live Production, Playout, Distribution, and OTT.
We’re a fast-growing, forward-thinking company built on transparency, innovation, and a team-player culture. Every team member makes a meaningful impact — we go beyond the job description to drive excellence.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Sales Operations Admin to join our global team and play a key role in scaling and optimizing our sales processes. This role is based in the Philippines and requires availability to work US business hours to support our North American sales leadership and teams.
You’ll be the backbone of our order-to-fulfillment operations, drive forecast accuracy, and enable Sales through data and operational excellence. This role is ideal for someone highly organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable working cross-functionally in a global environment.

Woring Hours: 9 - 6 ES

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Order Fulfillment & Licensing
  • Review and process purchase orders to ensure accuracy and compliance
  • Coordinate US license delivery ( cloud keys)
  • Manage the full order lifecycle across regions, tracking open cases and collaborating with Sales, TechOps, and Support
  • Lead regular syncs with Sales to clean pipelines and streamline processes
  • Track requests and issues via Jira and internal systems
  • Reporting & Renewals
  • Own the end-to-end subscription and renewal process in Salesforce
  • Provide accurate forecasts and insights on recurring revenue, renewals, churn risk, and expansion opportunities
  • Administrative & Executive Support (CRO)
  • Support the CRO with administrative and operational tasks, including Travel reports and other admin work as required

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Renewals Operations, or Business Analytics (B2B SaaS / Tech preferred)
  • Strong communication skills and fluent English (written and verbal)
  • Willingness and ability to work US business hours from the Philippines
  • Strong expertise in Salesforce
  • Advanced skills in Excel
  • Experience working with global teams and supporting US-based stakeholders
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence
  • Highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently

About 1840 & Company

1840 & Company is a global leader in Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and remote talent solutions, dedicated to propelling businesses forward through our comprehensive suite of services. We specialize in connecting companies with world-class freelance professionals and delivering top-tier outsourcing services, across over 150 countries worldwide.
Our mission is to empower growth for forward-thinking businesses, seamlessly bridging any skill or resource gaps with our expertly vetted talent pool. We firmly believe in fostering an environment where exceptional individuals can achieve an optimal work-life balance, working remotely from any location, while maximizing their professional growth and earning potential.
We are headquartered in Overland Park, KS, USA with service delivery facilities in the Philippines, India, Ukraine, South Africa and Argentina. We invite you to explore the opportunities we offer and consider joining our exclusive network of global freelance talent. Visit to learn more about us. jobs.description:
We are looking for a ServiceNow Developer to join the Sopra Steria Polska team and contribute to the projects for our clients.

Note that we can only offer cooperation to people who are located in Poland and have EU citizenship.

Responsibilities:​

  • Participate in ServiceNow implementation, enhancement, and optimization projects.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
  • Design, configure, and develop solutions on the ServiceNow platform, primarily within the ITSM module.
  • Develop and maintain workflows, integrations, catalog items, business rules, script includes, and other custom platform components.
  • Implement new functionalities and enhancements in accordance with business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions.
  • Review, optimize, and refactor custom code to ensure performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow best practices.
  • Support platform upgrades, patches, and releases, including testing and validation activities.
  • Monitor and maintain integrations and APIs to ensure reliable platform operations.
  • Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for configurations, integrations, and custom developments.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, consultants, and Agile teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Recommend and implement continuous improvements to enhance platform functionality, performance, and user experience.

Qualifications

Must Have Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform.
  • ServiceNow CSA (Certified System Administrator) certification.
  • Strong experience and deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM.
  • Advanced JavaScript scripting skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and familiarity with ITIL practices.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Fluent English B2/C1.
  • Strong communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Proactive and detail-oriented.
  • Ability to document processes and share knowledge effectively.
  • Being open to occasional business trips abroad and visits in our office in Katowice.

Nice to Have

  • Additional ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CAD, CIS-ITSM, CIS-HRSD, CIS-ITOM).
  • Experience with other ServiceNow modules, such as HRSD, SLO, ITOM, or similar.
  • French B2/C1.

What we offer:

- BENEFITS (UoP): Luxmed, Medicover Sport, Worksmile, educational platforms, languages learning platform, referral bonus, [copyrights* tbc], life insurance, certifications (paid by the company), conferences, Tech Lunches, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud), local kindergarten.

ADDITION: free parking, fresh fruits, workation.
In case of questions, please contact the HR team.

The recruitment process for this position consists of two stages:
• a short phone call with a recruiter (30 min max)
• one-hour long interview on Teams (with both general and technical questions)

Salary range:

UOP: 12 000 -16 000 PLN gross/month;

All information about salary range and its additional components will be provided during the 1st stage of recruitment process.

At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.

Sopra Steria is one of the largest players in the tech industry in Europe, known for its consulting, digital services and software development. We operate in nearly 30 countries in the world, hiring more than 55,000 employees.
The Polish branch, as the Global Delivery Center, operates in Katowice since 2007 and has been growing ever since. Currently, our team consists of around 1,000 specialists.

Within the Digital Platform Services department, our teams specialize in areas such as cloud, operating systems, virtualization, databases, backup or storage, as well as networking and security. We also have 1st line support consultants who speak French and English, but also Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and German.

The Application Services department is responsible for areas such as software development, data engineering, testing services, CRM, ITSM and ERP platform integrations, as well as application management for customers in Scandinavia, Benelux, France, Germany, Switzerland and the UK.

jobs.description:
Category: Technology

Location: Taguig National Capital Region (Manila) Philippines


About Us

We are a Managed Services Provider (MSP), VoIP Provider, and Fiber ISP deliveringcutting-edgetechnology solutions to businesses. Our services include managed IT support, network infrastructure, VoIP systems, cloud platforms, and fiber internet solutions.

We are expanding our team and looking for a Support & Systems Engineer who can own Level 2 and Level 3 support tickets, lead system and tenant migrations, manage SLAs and KPIs, improve documentation, and help oversee support operations.

This is a hands-on, leadership-oriented role requiring deep troubleshooting skills across Windows, Linux, networking, VoIP, security, automation, cloud platforms, and identity systems. This role also includes responsibility for planning and executing infrastructure and cloud migration projects. Participation in an on-call rotation for nights and weekends isrequiredas needed.

Key Responsibilities

-Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide advanced troubleshooting for Windows, Linux, and macOS systems
  • Manage Active Directory environments including GPOs, OUs, and hybrid AD setups
  • Troubleshoot complex networking issues involving firewalls, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, DHCP, DNS, and routing
  • Configure and maintainMikroTik, Juniper, and other enterprise network devices
  • Diagnose and resolve VoIP issues including SIP, PBX systems, Asterisk,FreePBX, 3CX, Kazoo, and QoS
  • Perform packet capture and traffic analysis using Wireshark,tcpdump, andMikroTikTorch
  • Support Azure AD (Entra ID), Intune, and identity management platforms including Okta and Zero Trust frameworks
  • Maintain and troubleshoot virtualized and hyper-converged environments (Hyper-V,VMware,StarWind,TrueNASScale,Proxmox)
  • Manage backup and disaster recovery solutions including Veeam
  • Implement security hardening, endpoint protection, MFA, and compliance best practices
  • Automate repetitive tasks using PowerShell, Python, or Bash

Migrations, Projects & Systems Engineering

  • Plan and execute cloud and identity migrations, including:
  • Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint)
  • Active Directory to Entra ID (Azure AD) and hybrid identity environments
  • Define project scope, technical requirements, timelines, risks, and success criteria
  • Build detailed project plans including milestones, dependencies, rollback strategies, and validation steps
  • Execute migrations with minimal downtime and clear communication to stakeholders
  • Coordinate with customers before, during, and after migrations to set expectations and provide updates
  • Perform post-migration validation, documentation, and optimization

Documentation, SOPs & Process Improvement

  • Maintain and improve documentation withinITGlue, Hudu, Confluence, and internal Wiki systems
  • Create and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), knowledge base articles, and internal training materials
  • Meet a weekly documentation quota to ensure systems, processes, and resolutions are consistently documented
  • Identifyinefficiencies and implement process improvements and automation

SLA, KPIs & Reporting

  • Ensure SLA compliance for ticket response and resolution times
  • Track KPIs related to support performance, migrations, and service delivery

jobs.description:
Payroll Executive

Company: Oriental Aviation International Pte Ltd
Location: Remote, PH
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Payroll & Administration Assistant to support the company's payroll operations and administrative functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for end-to-end payroll processing, employee records management, contract administration, and coordination of employee-related activities while ensuring compliance with company policies and relevant employment regulations.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Administration

  • Process monthly payroll accurately and on time for employees and external staff.
  • Maintain and reconcile employee timekeeping and attendance records.
  • Input and update employee information, including new hires, terminations, salary adjustments, and benefits in the payroll system.
  • Review and approve medical claims, leave records, and payroll-related transactions.
  • Perform payroll reconciliation and ensure compliance with payroll procedures and deadlines.
  • Manage payroll billing and related documentation.

Employee Records & Contract Management

  • Prepare employment contracts, contract renewals, and amendments for external staff.
  • Coordinate the distribution and collection of signed employment contracts.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee personnel files and records.
  • Ensure confidentiality and proper handling of employee information.

Administrative Support

  • Schedule and coordinate employee training courses and medical check-ups.
  • Maintain medical claims records and other HR administrative databases.
  • Prepare and submit monthly waiver of levy applications and other required employment-related submissions.
  • Assist with general administrative duties and documentation management.
  • Provide support on ad hoc administrative and payroll-related projects as assigned.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in payroll processing and administrative support.
  • Experience handling payroll software and Microsoft Excel.
  • Familiarity with payroll regulations, statutory requirements, and employment administration.
  • Knowledge of Singapore Ministry of Manpower (MOM) regulations is an advantage.
  • Experience in maintaining employee records and handling confidential information.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong numerical and analytical abilities.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Timely and accurate payroll processing.
  • Accuracy of employee records and payroll data.
  • Compliance with payroll and employment regulations.
  • Timely completion of administrative tasks and submissions.
  • Efficient management of employee documentation and contracts.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe IT System Admin is proficient in all roles taken on by the Imaging Informatics Analyst which are as follows: Implements, modifies, tests and administers modules and systems related to EPIC Radiant/PACS/Dictation system/Worklist Manager/Post-Processing applications.
jobs.description:
Overview

The IT System Admin is proficient in all roles taken on by the Imaging Informatics Analyst which are as follows: Implements, modifies, tests and administers modules and systems related to EPIC Radiant/PACS/Dictation system/Worklist Manager/Post-Processing applications. Serves as a liaison between vendors, IT personnel, external customers, other application analysts, management and end users to resolve questions related to system functionality and design. Analyze business and user needs, document requirements, and revises documentation as needed. Performs all analytical tasks as assigned in the development of each program and secures the documentation, testing, and final analysis to ensure job and system efficiency. Performs team and integrated testing for all functionality of clinical systems and their interfaces. Functions as a resource for users. In addition, develops, implements, modifies, tests and administers more complex modules and systems related to clinical applications. Acts on modifications when warranted. Responsible and accountable for the on-time completion of daily work, tasks and projects, demonstrating a commitment to meet established deadlines and priorities.

Responsibilities

Ensures the integrity and reliability of all radiology systems by assessing, making recommendations, and resolving hardware and software issues and requests. This includes determining feasibility and compatibility with the current systems while using best practices. Formulates and develops plans at a high level and documents required steps to achieve requirements. Reviews plans with management/peers as appropriate. Develops and maintains clear, understandable documentation to describe program development and modification, as well as troubleshooting. Update system and support documentation as necessary to reflect changes to programs, solutions, reports and interfaces. Updates management, customers and others as appropriate on a timely basis regarding progress on assigned tasks, projects and issues, via written or oral reports. Assists other IT teams with selection and provides technical evaluation of products /tools to ensure that the proposed solution adheres to the organizations requirements. May provide guidance to Applications System Analysts to ensure best practices, standard methodologies and processes are executed. Functions as a technical consultant to the health system, partnered regional hospitals, and maintains high service levels. Participates in system wide and partner initiatives to improve efficiency and reach institutional goals and objectives. Obtain knowledge of Industry Standards and best practices through conferences and seminars.

Qualifications

Certifications: Epic Certification - Radiant/Cupid within 6 months - EPICEPIC, Education: College Diploma: Radiologic Technology; Bachelor's Degree: Related Field, Work Experience: Clinical; Project management
